title: A Framework for Joint Affine and Diffeomorphic Image Registration
summary: Anatomical image registration commonly relies on a sequential pipeline where an affine alignment is estimated first and then held fixed while a non-rigid diffeomorphic deformation is applied. This two-step process often leads to suboptimal results, as the initial stage can absorb local deformations, biasing the residual passed to the diffeomorphic registration. To address this, we introduce a Joint Affine-Diffeomorphic framework, based on the large deformations model, that estimates both global affine and local diffeomorphic motions simultaneously within a single optimization.
